title: Create: Lost Casing Applications
description: Shadow steel and refined radiance casing creation implementation
body:
Requires Create
=======

A datapack that makes shadow steel casings by applying shadow steel to train casings and refined radiance casings by applying refined radiance to shadow steel casings.

**DOESN'T MAKE SHADOW STEEL AND REFINED RADIANCE ACTUALLY OBTAINABLE!!**

To obtain shadow steel and refined radiance, use 
```
/give @p create:shadow_steel
```
 and 
```
/give @p create:refined_radiance
```


I've made this datapack for my server where i've decided to use shadow steel and refined radiance as a currency. I thought it would be funny to also implement the casings. Well, turns out, appliance is a crafting recipe in create.
